service.description: NOTE: this service is meant for internal use and authentication is not required. Do not export or allow this service to be called remotely.

Send a stored EmailMessage that is not a draft. The server is the message's emailServerId, else the EmailServer of its mail client account (emailAccountId). A message of the mail client also brings its identity's reply-to address, its EmailMessageAttachment files (inline ones by Content-ID, in a related part) and its In-Reply-To and References headers (inReplyTo, referencesHeader). A Ready or Bounced message becomes Sent with its new messageId. A delivery that fails is a message, not an error, as in Java, and its text is sendError. A client message (one with an emailAccountId) is the mail client's to keep: what stops it after the status checks is its sendError, not an error, and its Sent status is written in the caller's transaction (a template's message in a new one, as in Java).

parameter.name: messageId
parameter.description: The Message-ID it went out with; empty when nothing was sent

service.description: Whether a server's settings work, for the mail account wizard; nothing is changed. SMTP connects, upgrades to TLS as configured and signs in; the store (when it has a storeHost) connects and signs in, and IMAP lists its folders. Each step is {step (smtp, storeLogin, storeList), ok, message}. folderList has each IMAP folder's {folderPath, delimiter, attributeList, folderKindEnumId}: INBOX, else its special-use attribute (\Sent, \Drafts, \Trash, \Junk, \Archive), else EfkOther. Use org.moqui.impl.EmailClientServices.test#EmailAccount, which checks the user may manage the account. SMTP signs in as smtpUsername when the server has one, else as mailUsername; smtpUsername and smtpPassword given here are tried instead of the stored ones (nothing is stored), so a wizard can test a separate SMTP sign-in before saving it.

parameter.name: smtpUsername
parameter.description: Given (even empty: the store's sign-in), the SMTP user to try

parameter.name: smtpPassword
parameter.description: Given, the SMTP password to try

service.description:
Poll an email server (IMAP or POP3) to receive messages. Each new message is processed using the Email-ECA rules. Messages are flagged as seen (if supported). Messages are deleted if the storeDelete flag is set on the moqui.basic.email.EmailServer record.
This is meant to be called as a scheduled service, run as often as you want to poll for new messages on a particular server (configured in the corresponding moqui.basic.email.EmailServer record).
Add a job in the quartz_data.xml file for this service to run this scheduled.

return.message: Found duplicate message with Message-ID [${messageId}] from server [${emailServerId}]

service-call.name: create#moqui.basic.email.EmailMessage
service-call.in-map: {sentDate:fields.sentDate, receivedDate:fields.receivedDate, statusId:statusId, subject:fields.subject, body:body, fromAddress:fields.from, toAddresses:fields.toList?.join(', '), ccAddresses:fields.ccList?.join(', '), bccAddresses:fields.bccList?.join(', '), messageId:messageId, emailServerId:emailServerId}

parameter.name: toAddresses
parameter.description: Comma separated list of to email addresses

parameter.name: ccAddresses
parameter.description: Comma separated list of CC email addresses

parameter.name: bccAddresses
parameter.description: Comma separated list of BCC email addresses
